resources.string: Send newly starred articles to selected services

Selected services receive the title and link of every article you star in any Brook account. Mastodon and Bluesky posts are public; linkding bookmarks are saved privately. Existing favorites are not sent.
Remove this connection and stop its pending posts? Posts already published will stay.
On your Mastodon instance, create an application in Preferences → Development with read:accounts, read:statuses and write:statuses. Paste its user access token, not your password.
Enter your PDS server (usually https://bsky.social), handle and an app password created in Bluesky settings. Do not use your main password.
Enter the address of your linkding instance and its API token from Settings → API token. Bookmarks stay private: an article you already bookmarked is left untouched instead of being saved twice.
Could not complete the operation. Check the server, credentials and network, then reconnect.
Waiting for delivery or verification. Offline attempts resume automatically.
Cannot publish: check the article URL, service limits and token permissions
Outcome uncertain. Check your profile before sharing manually. Automatic reposting is stopped to avoid duplicates.
